subject: Resale addendum — invoicing evidence & operational handoff
messages:
From: Zoe Park <z.park@cloudcart.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudCart Legal <legal@cloudcart.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resale addendum — invoicing evidence & ops handoff

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Legal asked us to put the resale/addendum redline questions in writing so we can move to procurement this week. Two specific asks from our finance and compliance teams: 

1) Evidence flow for invoices tied to marketplace passes — they want a short mapping that shows who issues invoices to end customers vs. distributor and what proof (invoice PDF, order id, connector logs) CloudCart needs to reconcile revenue.
2) Operational handoff: our onboarding team needs to confirm acceptance criteria (billing contact, technical connector owner, expected data retention for invoice traces) before we enable reseller billing.

Can you share a proposed mapping and the redline version of the addendum showing the pass-through clause you propose? If easier, a checklist for the onboarding team works too. We are on a tight window — procurement hopes to finalize by Friday 5/21.

Appreciate it,
Zoe

--
Zoe Park
Head of Partnerships
CloudCart Inc.
z.park@cloudcart.com
+1 415-555-0173
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Park <z.park@cloudcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Resale addendum — invoicing evidence & ops handoff

Hi Zoe — thanks, yes we can get that over. Attaching a draft redline and a concise evidence mapping template to fill (attached). Key notes up front:

- We propose Redwood issues invoices to the end customer when the usage originates from Redwood-hosted seats; where CloudCart is the billing entity in the marketplace flow, the addendum clarifies pass-through liability and requires CloudCart to provide invoice PDFs or reconciliation exports within 10 business days of Redwood's request.
- For evidence, we recommend the minimal required set: invoice PDF (customer-facing), marketplace order id, subscription id, and a reconciliation CSV export from CloudCart.
- Retention: we suggest both parties retain invoice/recon records for 3 years; if CloudCart requires a different retention for their audit needs, flag and we'll escalate to legal.

Action plan / timeline (to meet your Friday target):
1) Today: we send initial redline + evidence template (attached).
2) Thu 5/20: CloudCart fills evidence mapping and returns; Marissa and our procurement team review redlines.
3) Fri 5/21 EOD: aim to reach commercial agreement and trigger procurement signatures.

Attachments: redline_resale_addendum_20270519.docx (redline), evidence_mapping_template.xlsx (fillable)

If you prefer a short call to walk the template, Ben and I are available 10–11am PT tomorrow.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Park <z.park@cloudcart.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Resale addendum — invoicing evidence & ops handoff

Hi Zoe / Naomi,

I reviewed the attached redline and left inline comments. High-level comments for CloudCart legal: 

- Liability carve: Redwood can accept pass-through invoicing for marketplace sales provided CloudCart accepts responsibility for payment collection and any VAT/GST passthrough; we propose an explicit clause that CloudCart indemnifies Redwood for any taxes and chargebacks arising from CloudCart's billing.
- Evidence timeframe: 10 business days for initial request is OK; add a remediation window (15 business days) for production of missing artifacts, after which Redwood may suspend resale billing for new orders until evidence is provided.
- Audit rights: propose mutual audit rights limited to once per 12 months with 30 days' notice; CloudCart asked for broader rights but we should cap scope to billing-specific artifacts.

I attached a PDF export of the redline with comments and an exhibit outline for evidence mapping. Please confirm whether the proposed indemnity and suspension remediation terms are acceptable; if CloudCart needs alternative language, include suggested text on the evidence_mapping_template spreadsheet.

Attachments: redline_resale_addendum_20270519.docx (redline with comments), evidence_mapping_exhibit.pdf

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call tomorrow with Procurement / Legal if CloudCart wants to workshop the clauses.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts & Partner Legal
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Sebastian Torres <s.torres@cloudcart.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zoe Park <z.park@cloudcart.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Resale addendum — invoicing evidence & ops handoff

Marissa / Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the exhibit. We reviewed internally and CloudCart can accept the 10-business-day window but need the remediation window reduced to 10 business days (we have tighter finance cycles). Regarding indemnity: we can accept indemnity for taxes but will not agree to suspension language that blocks customer billing without a joint escalation — we propose "good faith remediation & escalation" path with a 10-business-day remediation plus a 5-business-day mediation step before any suspension.

We filled the evidence_mapping_template (attached) and added sample reconciliation extracts. Also attached a short note from our procurement lead on how our marketplace issues invoices when CloudCart is the marketplace seller.

Attachments: evidence_mapping_filled.xlsx, procurement_note_marketplace_invoicing.pdf

Next steps: Naomi, can you confirm Redwood's ability to accept the smaller remediation window and the suggested mediation step? If so, we'll aim for signatures Monday morning and route to procurement.

—Sebastian
Sebastian Torres
Director of Finance Ops
CloudCart Inc.
s.torres@cloudcart.com
